headline: Uniinfo Telecom Services appoints Manojkumar Bhagirathprasad Rawat as Non-Executive Independent Director
hook: New independent board member at Uniinfo
summary: Uniinfo Telecom Services Limited has announced the appointment of Manojkumar Bhagirathprasad Rawat as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective July 18, 2026. This corporate governance update reflects a board-level addition for the telecom services firm. Retail investors can view this as a routine procedural filing regarding board composition with no immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with no direct financial impact

headline: Uniinfo Telecom Services appoints M/s. Harish Khandelwal & Co. as statutory auditors
hook: New statutory auditors appointed at Uniinfo
summary: Uniinfo Telecom Services Limited has informed the stock exchange about the appointment of M/s. Harish Khandelwal & Co. as its new statutory auditors. The firm, holding registration number 004116C, takes over the auditing responsibilities for the company. Such routine changes in statutory auditors are standard corporate governance procedures for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note this administrative update for their records.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative update with no direct impact on share price

hook: Routine shareholder meeting concluded at Uniinfo
summary: Uniinfo Telecom Services announced the outcome of its 16th Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. headline: Uniinfo Telecom Services files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
